summary: Image decoder work focused on correctness and efficiency: JPEG XL (JXL) now recognizes common color spaces via CICP enums instead of synthesizing ICC profiles, with extra JXL decoder logging to aid troubleshooting. AVIF decoding using dav1d now scales threads by image size to avoid per-thread overhead, improving performance and lowering CPU use, and a moz-icon filename fix prevents malformed placeholders from propagating. Together these changes give more accurate colors, faster AVIF loads on diverse hardware, and clearer debugging.
